tasks.gr12-paper-1-revision-t4: Topic: Paper 1 Revision. Revise company accounting, published financial statements, cash flow, financial indicators, governance and ethics. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret Paper 1 figures, classify company transactions, or recommend governance improvements using CAPS terminology.
tasks.gr12-paper-2-revision-t4: Topic: Paper 2 Revision. Revise inventory, fixed assets, manufacturing, reconciliations, VAT, budgeting and related controls. Ask Grade 12 learners to solve mixed Paper 2 calculations, identify control weaknesses, or explain the effect of valuation and reconciliation adjustments.
tasks.gr12-exam-readiness-strategies-t4: Topic: Exam Readiness Strategies. Cover final Grade 12 Accounting revision habits tied to content accuracy, figures-based interpretation, ethics, internal control and exam technique. Ask Grade 12 learners to choose the best accounting judgement, avoid common exam errors, or apply a key exam principle to a CAPS scenario.
